sources.entry: Velinshot - Free native screenshot editor with annotations, custom frames and local OCR (unnotarized preview). [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Jacknelson6/Velinshot) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: Velinshot is a free native screenshot editor for Mac and Windows that captures, frames, annotates and copies screenshots, keeping them on the device.
keywords: add arrows and text to screenshot
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Velinshot as free, native screenshot editing for Mac and Windows, covering capture, framing, annotation and copying. It states there is no account, analytics or watermark, and that screenshots stay on the device unless the user shares them. The one-line listing also mentions local OCR. The Mac build targets Apple Silicon on macOS 14+, and the Windows build targets x64 on Windows 10 (2004+) or 11. Mac setup requires granting screen capture permission in System Settings and restarting the app. The README also links to separate guides for Mac, Windows and Mac updates, plus build-from-source and contributing docs.
use_cases: Annotating screenshots with arrows, text or shapes
Adding custom frames or borders to screenshots
Capturing and copying screenshots quickly on Mac or Windows
Extracting text from screenshots locally with OCR
Keeping screenshots private without cloud upload
how_to_run: Download the Mac build (Apple Silicon, macOS 14+) or the Windows build (x64, Windows 10 2004+ or 11) from the repository's releases links
Mac: drag Velinshot.app into Applications and open the installed copy
Mac: if blocked, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Security → Open Anyway, then confirm Open
Mac: in Velinshot → Settings, click Request capture access…, enable Velinshot under Screen & System Audio Recording (or Screen Recording), then quit and reopen
Windows: the preview is unsigned and may trigger SmartScreen; see the Windows opening guide
To build from source, follow the README's 'Build from source' section
notable: Free, with no account, analytics or watermark, per the README
Screenshots stay on the device unless the user shares them
Includes local OCR according to the listing description
Separate Screen Recording permission step on Mac, distinct from opening the app
MIT license named in the README
caveats: The Mac build is a free preview that is not Apple-notarized, so Gatekeeper may block it on first launch
The Windows preview is unsigned and may show SmartScreen warnings
Mac requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later; Windows requires Windows 10 (2004+) or 11, x64 only
